response.courseDescription: 308 Functional Anatomy and Physiology of Domestic Animals Functional anatomy of domestic animals including the study of the musculoskeletal, neuromuscular, cardiovascular, digestive, and urogenital systems. Highlighting the relevance of functional anatomy in real-world applications. Recommended preparations BIOLOGY 102 or BIOLOGY 106.
